verdict.rationale: Twilio Video documents official native SDKs for JavaScript (Web), iOS (Swift/Objective-C) and Android (Java/Kotlin). They are backed by quickstart guides, open-sourced reference apps and a documented REST API for Rooms. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and evidence of official server-side SDKs or helper libraries beyond the raw REST API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
